description: ai-ecoverse/slicc-jsh#1158: an uncaught Error whose stack has no frames (a reassigned err.stack, an empty one, Error.stackTraceLimit = 0), thrown by the -e or piped stdin script itself, prints as Node 22.22.0 prints it: the throw's source line and caret, then the stack, all in brackets, then the error's own properties; the line is the script's first throw, not one in a comment or a string; and --input-type=module with -p is Node's ERR_EVAL_ESM_CANNOT_PRINT report, its internal header, frames and code
